purpose: Separate Medicare Advantage payment-integrity, care-access, remedy, and public-recovery questions so MA evidence does not become either comfort evidence or a blanket condemnation.

layers.acceptance_test: bind risk adjustment/coding/favorable selection to contract-level bids, rebates, margins, quality, audits, and recoveries
bind denial/appeal/overturn to service setting, plan, contractor, medical-necessity review, delay, and beneficiary harm
distinguish aggregate CMS-reported volume from plan-service-level incidence
track final rule, compliance dates, API/metric reporting, and whether public data become outcome-useful
identify rate corrections, audit recoupment, penalties, automatic approvals, expedited appeals, beneficiary compensation, and parent/contractor accountability

hard_blockers: No certification from MedPAC/CMS current payment context without contract-level public-loss/recovery records.
No certification from OIG/KFF denial evidence without service-level medical-necessity and harm/outcome records.
No certification from proposed CMS rulemaking until implementation and actual metric data are available.
No public-balance-sheet pass unless ordinary claimants are senior to plan/coding/UM contractor extraction.

rev0372_contract_certification_layers.purpose: Provide contract_id, plan_id, parent organization, enrollment, service area, and denominator keys.
Acquire and validate denial/appeal disposition rows at contract level; public plan-service detail remains blocker.
Bind internal coverage criteria and delegated-entity context; criteria do not prove outcome correctness.
Join audited-contract/payment-year/results/overpayment data to public-recovery and payment-integrity claims.
Still requires appeal timeliness, delay/harm, remedy, enforcement, and compensation records.

remaining_decisive_blockers: contract-level LDS acquisition or public release
RADV result/recovery join to payment and plan finance records
delegated-entity accountability and clinical contrary evidence
